EnglishEspañol

A learning recommendation is not your result

Read evidence labels, distinguish dates and design a fairer comparison.

The WWC’s 2007 landing page gives different evidence ratings to different recommendations. It assigns moderate evidence to spreading study over time and strong evidence to using quizzes to revisit important content. Those are the guide’s ratings for its scope, not measured outcomes for this atlas.

Consider an original fictional example: one class scores 8 out of 10 after a practice activity; another scores 6. Their starting knowledge, teacher, assessment conditions and assignment method are unknown. The difference alone cannot isolate the activity’s effect.

The selected Crossref record reports a January 2013 publication and a 2026 indexing timestamp. Updating an index does not turn the article into a 2026 study.

What can the fictional scores establish?

Compare your reasoning

8 − 6 = 2 describes these scores. Assignment and comparison evidence are needed for a causal conclusion.

Which year describes the article’s reported publication?

Compare your reasoning

The publication and indexing fields refer to different events. A metadata refresh is not a new experiment.

Which next step addresses a comparison problem?

Compare your reasoning

Preference may be useful for a different question. A common outcome and an explicit assignment design help assess a learning-effect claim; they do not automatically remove all bias.

Take it further

Write a prediction, a delayed explanation task and two alternative explanations for the result. Do not record a learning gain until an actual comparison exists.

Your notes

Notes stay on this page until you download them. Nothing is sent or automatically saved.

EnglishEspañol

Una recomendación educativa no es tu resultado

Lee las etiquetas de evidencia, distingue fechas y diseña una comparación más justa.

La página del WWC de 2007 asigna distintos niveles de evidencia a distintas recomendaciones. Indica evidencia moderada para distribuir el estudio en el tiempo y sólida para usar cuestionarios que permitan volver al contenido importante. Son valoraciones de esa guía dentro de su alcance, no resultados medidos de este atlas.

Considera un ejemplo ficticio original: una clase obtiene 8 de 10 después de una actividad de práctica; otra obtiene 6. Se desconocen los conocimientos iniciales, el docente, las condiciones de evaluación y el método de asignación. La diferencia no permite aislar el efecto de la actividad.

El registro seleccionado de Crossref indica una publicación de enero de 2013 y una fecha de indexación de 2026. Actualizar un índice no convierte el artículo en un estudio de 2026.

¿Qué permiten establecer las puntuaciones ficticias?

Compara tu razonamiento

8 − 6 = 2 describe estas puntuaciones. Para una conclusión causal hacen falta datos sobre la asignación y la comparación.

¿Qué año corresponde a la publicación indicada del artículo?

Compara tu razonamiento

Los campos de publicación e indexación se refieren a acontecimientos distintos. Una actualización de metadatos no es un experimento nuevo.

¿Qué paso aborda un problema de comparación?

Compara tu razonamiento

La preferencia puede servir para otra pregunta. Un resultado común y un diseño de asignación explícito ayudan a evaluar un efecto sobre el aprendizaje; no eliminan automáticamente todo sesgo.

Ve más allá

Escribe una predicción, una tarea de explicación diferida y dos explicaciones alternativas del resultado. No registres una mejora de aprendizaje sin una comparación real.

Tus notas

Las notas permanecen en esta página hasta que las descargues. No se envían ni se guardan automáticamente.

evidence.text:
# Local programme author check — 23 October 2026

Four original studies contain English and Spanish editorial editions and twelve shared reasoning tasks. The author read the stated WWC recommendations/evidence labels, National Gallery account, and OpenStax accounting sections. The selected Crossref record was captured and its publication/deposit/index fields read separately. Earlier Open Library capture hashes matched their retained packet; those are retained observations, not fresh API readings. No source media, abstract or extended quotation is reproduced. The new LOC SRU page timed out and was not retried.

The first ten offline groups passed: exact accepted depth targets, prerequisite traversal with missing nodes and cycles, language/task completeness, independent study identities and stale-check detection, ledger conservation plus omission/unequal-entry counterexamples, separate provider identities and missing fields, separate Crossref dates and excluded abstracts, bounded retrieval failures without retries, honest practice-note exports, and static/escaped rendering. The original fictional ledger yields cash 810, equipment 240, liabilities 150, equity 900 and assets 1050; omitting the entire borrowing entry still balances and is explicitly wrong.

Spanish is an AI-author editorial edition, not a professionally or community-validated translation. Source metadata remains in its observed language. The National Gallery age discrepancy is excluded from conclusions. The source-reading scope and reuse boundaries are recorded in program/research.json and program/federated-catalog.json.

These are local author checks, not independent review, certification or observed learning. Native-browser and assembled-delivery evidence will be recorded in a separate delivery receipt after execution. This source receipt is retained unchanged with each new edition.
